item.title: Remote Full-Time Designer Needed
item.description:

Monitor hosting, SSL certificates, security, backups, and uptime. Improve website layouts, navigation, graphics, and functionality. Maintain consistent company branding across all websites. 2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Perform on-page, off-page, and technical SEO. Optimize website content, titles, descriptions, keywords, and internal links. Improve Google search visibility and organic traffic. Identify and correct indexing, crawling, and performance issues. Manage Google Search Console and Google Analytics. Research relevant keywords and identify opportunities for growth. Improve existing pages and develop SEO-focused landing pages. Monitor search rankings and report measurable improvements. 3. Email Marketing & Campaign Management Create and send professional HTML email marketing campaigns. Design attractive promotional emails and newsletters. Manage email marketing platforms and subscriber lists. Set up and maintain email automation campaigns. Monitor email delivery, open rates, click rates, and conversions. Perform campaign testing and improve marketing performance. Maintain email authentication and deliverability standards. Follow applicable email marketing and unsubscribe requirements. 4. Data Card Publishing & Video Marketing Publish and update mailing list data cards on NextMark and company websites. Maintain accurate descriptions, categories, pricing, and related information. Create short promotional videos of approximately 30 seconds for newly published data cards. Upload promotional videos to the appropriate data cards and company YouTube channels. Optimize video titles, descriptions, and keywords. Keep product information consistent across all marketing platforms. 5. General Webmaster Responsibilities Monitor website performance and resolve problems promptly. Review websites for outdated content, broken images, and display problems. Maintain website security and perform routine updates. Improve conversion rates and lead generation. Create promotional banners, graphics, and marketing materials. Coordinate website improvements and new development projects. Recommend practical improvements that increase traffic, inquiries, and sales. Handle other technical and digital marketing responsibilities associated with a professional webmaster position.
Required Qualifications
Minimum 3–5 years of professional webmaster or web development experience. Advanced WordPress administration and development skills. Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP. Proven experience with technical SEO and Google search optimization. Experience managing multiple commercial websites simultaneously. Experience creating and distributing HTML email campaigns. Familiarity with Google Analytics, Search Console, and SEO software. Ability to troubleshoot hosting, DNS, SSL, and website performance issues. Basic graphic design and video editing capabilities. Strong written English and communication skills. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work independently without constant supervision.
Work Schedule & Accountability
This is a dedicated, full-time position requiring 40 actual working hours per week. The successful candidate must: Maintain a consistent, agreed-upon work schedule. Provide a daily work report detailing completed assignments. Maintain a weekly task schedule with priorities and deadlines. Demonstrate measurable progress on assigned projects. Communicate regularly and respond promptly during working hours. Prioritize high-traffic and revenue-producing websites. Be available for scheduled meetings and project reviews. We expect productivity, accountability, and completed assignments — not simply hours logged.

Monthly Salary: $1,000–$1,500 USD Compensation will depend on experience, technical qualifications, and demonstrated ability. This is a long-term opportunity with the potential for increased compensation based on performance and results.
How to Apply
Please provide the following information with your application: Your professional experience managing WordPress websites. Examples of websites you have personally developed or maintained. Your experience managing large portfolios of websites. Examples of successful SEO improvements you have achieved. Your experience with HTML email marketing campaigns. Your knowledge of video editing and YouTube publishing. Your expected monthly salary. Confirmation that you can dedicate 40 hours per week to this position. item.title: Private Shopify Custom App: AI-Assisted Hardware Diagnostics Pipeline
item.description:
250-750 USD | We are launching a high-ticket consumer appliance sales and mechanical repair service business in the United States. We are utilizing a standard Shopify platform to manage hardware sales, parts inventory, and recurring care service memberships. We require an experienced full-stack developer to build a private, custom Shopify application to streamline our mechanical repair diagnostics pipeline. The app will act as a training copilot to help bench technicians troubleshoot and execute repairs with high speed and precision. To minimize development hours and keep our budget tight, the internal technician dashboard must be built using an embedded low-code framework (such as Retool or Bubble) integrated directly within our Shopify Admin panel via a secure app proxy or iframe.
Core Workflow & High-Level Requirements
1. Customer Front-End Intake (Liquid/Shopify UI)
• A clean submission page embedded on our live Shopify storefront. • The customer inputs hardware metadata, describes the symptoms, and uploads a clear photo or short video snippet of the mechanical issue (up to 10MB). • Data Parameter: Data writes directly to a secure backend database (PostgreSQL/Supabase preferred) and links to their Shopify Customer Profile. No processing or automated data is shown to the end customer.
2. Private Technician Bench Panel (Retool or Bubble Embedded)
• A hidden dashboard embedded inside the Shopify Admin panel for our internal bench technicians. • Displays a queue of incoming open repair tickets. Clicking a ticket loads the customer's text/image metadata alongside an internal diagnostic workflow tool. • The AI Integration: Technicians trigger an internal action passing the context to a multimodal LLM API (gpt-4o or similar). The API references custom technical documentation files mapped in our database to return a structured troubleshooting guide onto the bench display.

I am looking for an experienced AI developer to complete the setup and integration of a multipurpose AI agent using existing infrastructure.
**Existing Infrastructure**
* Hetzner VPS running Ubuntu. * Docker environment. * Self-hosted n8n automation platform. * Existing web interface. * GitHub account. * OpenAI API access.

**1. AI Models**
* Integrate OpenAI models through the API. * Integrate Mistral AI models. * Configure the system to use appropriate models for different tasks. * Allow additional models to be integrated in the future.
**2. AI Agent and Interface**
* Configure the multipurpose AI agent. * Connect the agent to n8n for workflow execution. * Enable the agent to use authorised tools and external APIs. * Integrate with the existing web interface.
**3. Business Integrations**
Initial integrations will include:
* Shopify e-commerce store. * Easyship shipping and fulfilment. * Supplier APIs and additional business tools as required.
**4. Technical Requirements**
* Work with the existing infrastructure rather than rebuilding it. * Configure secure API connections and credentials. * Ensure reliable workflow execution, error handling and logging. * Provide documentation and a complete handover.
### Developer Requirements
Experience required in:
* OpenAI API and Mistral AI. * n8n and AI agent development. * REST APIs, webhooks and integrations. * Docker, Ubuntu and self-hosted applications. * Shopify API integration.
### Application Questions
Please provide:
1. Examples of AI agents you have developed using n8n. 2. Your experience integrating OpenAI and Mistral models. 3. Your proposed implementation approach. 4. Estimated cost, delivery time and any additional running costs.
